narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in Delaware on July 16. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to around 6 inches.
ev: Flood waters inundated parts of a farmstead to the west of Georgetown. Some livestock was relocated due to the flooding.
Flood waters reached at least 12 homes in Greenwood. The rising water was reported to have damaged 4 vehicles.
lsr: Report from Sunday morning, relayed through media. Farmstead flooded, had to relocate animals due to flooding.
Sussex County EM reports 4 homes with water intrusion, 4 vehicles with water damage, with DelDOT assisting with water on the roadways.
